context.why: The team recognized that cross-session and multi-agent continuity is already a day-zero problem, so Proofpress should be positioned immediately as an open protocol and trust layer while portable artifacts remain the carrier and the ledger remains the core model.
rejected: Handoff protocol as the category — handoff is an action and sounds narrower than the open trust layer Proofpress provides.
Keep open protocol as a long-term category — multiple agent sessions already need shared checkable artifact state today.
Use the larger positioning to justify protocol-first engineering — category ambition should be proven through a narrow Markdown CLI and harness reference implementation.
